title: The outage from Monday: what now?
prompt: Back to the cold open. Search is unavailable to all users. The customer admin is a Designated Support Contact. What do you advise?

options.text: Post in the shared chat channel and email a known contact, then open a ticket later if nobody answers.
options.feedback: Not this one. Response times cannot be tracked accurately outside the support portal, so the clock does not start.

options.text: Sign in to Gleaniverse, open the support widget, create an Urgent ticket with all six details, and add any new evidence to that same ticket.
options.feedback: Correct. Only portal incidents are SLA-eligible. A complete Urgent ticket for a full outage starts the tracked response, and the ticket stays the system of record.

options.text: Open a High ticket now and a second Urgent ticket in an hour to make sure it gets seen.
options.feedback: Not this one. The outage is Urgent by definition. Duplicate tickets and incorrect priority slow triage for everyone.

takeaway: Escalate inside the portal: correct priority, complete evidence, one ticket.
footnote: Studio guidance: if a tracked ticket needs more attention, update that ticket and confirm its priority first. For partner-specific escalation paths, confirm your path with the Glean partner team.
